about: Capstone S0: the bootstrap driver. A build is a function of the source and the Go release; a seed is rebuilt from its source and never trusted; a landed stage's capstone rows hold.

mutants.name: s0-no-trimpath
mutants.rule: The checkout's path does not reach the binary.

mutants.name: s0-vcs-stamped
mutants.rule: The checkout's git state does not reach the binary.

mutants.name: s0-environment-leaks
mutants.rule: Only the variables that locate programs and caches pass to go build.

mutants.name: s0-go-env-file-read
mutants.rule: The user's go env file does not reach the binary.

mutants.name: s0-cgo-by-host
mutants.rule: Whether the host has a C compiler does not reach the binary.

mutants.name: s0-cached-seed-trusted
mutants.from: if sum, err := fileSum(path); err == nil && sum == want {
mutants.rule: A cached seed is used only with the lock's digest.

mutants.name: s0-rebuilt-seed-unchecked
mutants.rule: A seed rebuilt from its source is refused unless its digest is the lock's.

mutants.name: s0-verify-unchecked
mutants.rule: verify-seed fails when the source does not build the lock's digest.

mutants.name: s0-go-release-unchecked
mutants.rule: A seed built by another Go release than the lock names is refused.

mutants.name: s0-tag-unchecked
mutants.to: if err == nil && tag != l.Source && false {
mutants.rule: A tag of the seed's name that names another commit is refused.

mutants.name: s0-download-unchecked
mutants.to: if got := hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)); got != want && false {
mutants.rule: A downloaded seed is kept only with the lock's digest.

mutants.name: s0-download-status-unchecked
mutants.rule: A release that is not published (404) is no release: the seed is rebuilt from source.

mutants.name: s0-bad-download-rebuilt
mutants.rule: A download with another digest is refused, not hidden behind a rebuild.

mutants.name: s0-url-template-wrong
mutants.rule: The lock's url names the asset of the platform.

mutants.name: s0-compiler-packages-ignored
mutants.rule: A tree with Ergo compiler packages is refused until the mixed-binary step exists, never built without them.

mutants.name: s0-lock-row-reads-elsewhere
mutants.rule: The capstone row of the seed lock reads toolchain/seed.lock, and S0 has landed.
